articles.title: FIIs hold $717 billion worth of Indian stocks, but trim exposure across 56% of Nifty 500 companies. Where are they investing?

articles.title: Global Market: Binance breach rekindles fears over cryptocurrency security
articles.content: A reported $6.3 billion breach at Binance, described as the largest crypto heist on record, has renewed concerns about digital-asset security. Binance has located about $3 billion in affected assets and pledged to cover losses. The incident joins major attacks on Bybit, Ronin Network, Wormhole and other platforms, highlighting persistent vulnerabilities across exchanges, wallets, blockchain bridges and DeFi services.

articles.title: Global Market: Bank of Japan achieves 2% inflation target after 13 years
articles.content: The Bank of Japan declared its long-standing 2% inflation target achieved after more than 13 years, but kept its benchmark interest rate unchanged at 1.25%. articles.content: The Bank of Japan will accelerate the sale of its exchange-traded fund holdings, targeting annual disposals of 860 billion yen ($5.45 billion) at book value, equivalent to around 0.1% of market trading value.
